title: Aquarius’ tree is a cactus.
caption: Aquarius threw an anti-holiday party around a cactus in 2016 and confused every guest. Same cactus now, plus lights, two stockings and someone who thinks it is perfect. Weird lasts when it is shared. Who is your Aquarius?
